610338df14f4cebede6d1bb7ae7c1333ab864e87.summary: CrowdStrike's profile of the eCrime adversary Scattered Spider says it has run financially motivated activity since early 2022. Its early campaigns mainly targeted customer relationship management and business-process outsourcing firms, plus telecommunications and technology companies, and it monetised intrusions. The profile lists targeting in the United States, United Kingdom, Western Europe, North America, the Americas and Europe, and gives several alternative names. The profile text is cut off after its first paragraph.
